whatIsInkVerify.title: What is Ink Verify?
whatIsInkVerify.description: Ink Verify is public infrastructure for onchain attestations of offchain and onchain data, powered by <eas-link>Ethereum Attestation Service</eas-link>

whyVerify.title: Why verify?
whyVerify.description: Join us in building openly with Ink Verify to confirm attendance, earn tooling rewards, and share your use cases.

verifications.title: Available verifications
verifications.description: Discover the latest verifications on Ink

whatIsVerify.title: What is Ink Verify?
whatIsVerify.description: Ink Verify allows you to verify that your wallet address is associated with your Kraken account by making an onchain attestation. By verifying, you can begin to access exclusive features across Ink.

whyVerify.title: What partners or dApps support Ink Verify?
whyVerify.description: We're actively onboarding partners! GM will be the first to support onchain verification based features.

whatGoesOnchain.title: What goes onchain?
whatGoesOnchain.description: We only store your wallet address and a confirmation that it's been verified - nothing more.

payforGas.title: Do I have to pay for gas?
payforGas.description: No! We cover the gas fees for you.

numberofAddresses.title: How many addresses can I verify?
numberofAddresses.description: You can verify one address at a time. Changing addresses is easy, simply revoke and re-verify with a new address.

howDoesitWork.title: How does it work?
howDoesitWork.description: Ink Verify uses the <eas-link>Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS)</eas-link> on Ink to issue onchain attestations. EAS is a standard protocol for making trusted claims about onchain or offchain data — stored securely onchain.

wherecaniView.title: Where can I view my onchain verification?
wherecaniView.description: When you verify, a notification will appear that links you to the transaction tied to your attestation.

wrongAddress.title: I connected the wrong wallet, what should I do?
wrongAddress.description: Revoke the verification and verify again with the correct address.

support.title: Where can I get support?
support.description: If you have any questions or concerns, please take a look at our <support-link>Support Center article</support-link>.

devSupport.title: I'm a developer and I want to integrate, how do I get started?
devSupport.description: To integrate with Ink Verify, check out our <docs-link>documentation here</docs-link>.

About.title: What is Ink?
About.description: Ink is an Ethereum layer 2 blockchain, built on the OP Stack, designed to be the house of DeFi for the Superchain. Ink will empower onchain builders to deploy new and innovative DeFi protocols for the next billion users onchain.

readyToInk.title: Ready To INK the Future?
readyToInk.description: The Ink ecosystem empowers founders, hackers, researchers, and creators to craft the next era of onchain experiences. From launching startups and scaling dApps to deploying robust infrastructure, we cover relevant programs to fulfill your vision and build alongside a global network of innovators.

ourFocus.title: Our Focus
ourFocus.description: Ink backs builders shaping the future of onchain capital markets — across trading, infra, consumer experiences, and real-world finance.

echo.title: ECHO
echo.description: We truly appreciate pioneers who built on INK from the beginning. This program has now closed — thank you to all who applied.

step1.title: Submit
step1.description: Choose the builder track that fits you best. Fill out the application form with your idea and goals.

step2.title: Review
step2.description: The Ink team reviews submissions every 1–2 weeks. We assess clarity, fit, and ambitions. You may be contacted for async follow-up or a call.

step3.title: Decision & Support
step3.description: If you're approved, receive a grant offer or retro reward, get matched with a point of contact, and join the Ink builder channel to get started.

benefits.title: Builder Benefits & Support
benefits.description: Ink backs builders shaping the future of onchain capital markets — across trading, infra, consumer experiences, and real-world finance.

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.q1: Who can apply to INK's builder programs?
faqs.a1: Anyone building on Ink or planning to — from solo devs and small teams to established projects. Whether you're pre-launch or already live, we welcome applications across DeFi, infrastructure, consumer apps, and more.
faqs.q2: How do I know which track to apply for?
faqs.a2: Spark is for early-stage builders who need initial support to get started. Forge is for teams with a working product ready to scale. Echo is for established projects looking for strategic growth partnerships. If you're unsure, apply to the one that feels closest — we'll help route you.
faqs.q3: What does the review process look like?
faqs.a3: After you submit your application, our team reviews it for alignment with Ink's ecosystem priorities. Strong applications are invited to a follow-up conversation. The process typically takes 2–4 weeks from submission to decision.
faqs.q4: Do I need a company or team to apply?
faqs.a4: No. Solo developers and individual contributors are welcome to apply, especially to the Spark track. All we need is a clear idea of what you're building and how it benefits the Ink ecosystem.
faqs.q5: What can the grant be used for?
faqs.a5: Grants can be used for development costs, audits, infrastructure, hiring, go-to-market activities, and other expenses directly tied to building and growing your project on Ink.
faqs.q6: How long does it take to hear back?
faqs.a6: We aim to respond to all applications within 2–4 weeks. If your application moves forward, you'll be contacted for a follow-up discussion.
faqs.q7: I applied but didn't get selected. Can I apply again?
faqs.a7: Absolutely. Many builders iterate on their ideas and reapply successfully. We encourage you to take any feedback into account and submit a new application when you're ready.
faqs.q8: How do I stay in the loop?
faqs.a8: Follow us on X (@inkonchain), join our Discord, and check the Ink docs for the latest updates on builder programs, ecosystem news, and opportunities.

ethdenver.title: Join us at the House of Ink in Denver
ethdenver.description: Join us at the House of Ink, a 5-day immersive hacker house experience during ETH Denver, where innovation meets collaboration! Explore the power of Ink, dive into smart contract development, and gain hands-on expertise through interactive workshops and tooling overviews.
